title: Replace the noun with an attached pronoun
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y6 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: replace the noun with an attached pronoun)
intro: Lesson 17: Pronouns attached to verbs: أُسَاعِدُهَا، أُحِبُّهَا. To understand how object pronouns attach to the end of verbs in Arabic

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: أُمِّي is a woman: use ـهَا

questions.model: Teacher: أَبِي is a man, so use ـهُ. أُسَاعِدُ + هُ = أُسَاعِدُهُ.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF: rewrite eight sentences replacing the person with an attached pronoun (for example: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي → أَزُورُهَا), then write two of your own about your family.
questions.a: Correct endings: ـهُ for males, ـهَا for females, ـنِي and ـنَا where needed; two own sentences
questions.model: Teacher does sentence 1: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي → أَزُورُهَا.

questions.q: write 'my mother teaches me': أُمِّي تُعَلِّمُنِي.
Back to our ponder: how does Arabic say 'I help her' in one word?
questions.a: The pronoun attaches to the verb
